formation: Originally written as 桀, which depicts two feet (舛) on top of a tree (木). 亻 (person) was later added to the character as a meaning component. Based on the original meaning, "to be elevated". The meaning later shifted to "outstanding person" and "hero".

components.note: 亻 is a component form of 人.
Depicts two feet (舛) on top of a tree (木).
